Create Quarto book reports with the INRAE template

Source: R/create_book.R
create_book.Rd

Same as kquarto.r::create_book(), with the INRAE template by default: INRAE colours and fonts, logo, title page and bibliography (references.bib).

Usage

create_book(dirname_reports, ..., template = inrae_template())

Arguments

dirname_reports

Character vector of report folder names.

...

Other arguments passed to kquarto.r::create_book(), e.g. path, title, author, chapters.

template

Template used to initialise the reports. Defaults to inrae_template().

Value

The paths of the report folders, invisibly.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile()
dir.create(tmp)
create_book(
  "rapport_technique",
  path = tmp,
  title = "Rapport technique",
  author = "Kevin Orlando",
  chapters = c("Introduction", "Méthodes")
)
#> Book(s) created: rapport_technique
list.files(file.path(tmp, "rapport_technique"), recursive = TRUE)
#> [1] "_quarto.yml"                  "chapitre-01-introduction.qmd"
#> [3] "chapitre-02-methodes.qmd"     "images/logo-inrae.png"       
#> [5] "index.qmd"                    "inrae.scss"                  
#> [7] "references.bib"
